verdict.rationale: Deel documents a first-party API endpoint to create a contractor contract (POST /rest/contracts), and an official MCP server that lets agents invoke Deel API operations. Together these cover the start of an agent-driven hire, but the evidence shows only contractor contract creation, not employee creation, compensation setup, or tax setup. Missing for 10: employee (non-contractor) creation endpoint, compensation setup via API, tax setup via API, evidence of an end-to-end onboarding flow, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent onboard a new hire end-to-end via the API — creating the employee, compensation, and tax setup

citations.quote: Create a contractor contract POST https://api.letsdeel.com/rest/contracts

The Deel MCP server exposes tools that map to Deel API operations.
